description: We are Vibe Coders 001, a team of technology enthusiasts participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are building TerraTrend, an interactive platform that uses NASA Earth observation data to investigate environmental trends, identify regional changes, and communicate scientific insights through data visualizations. Our interests include Python, data analytics, Earth science, and software development.
summary:
TerraTrend is an interactive climate data visualization platform designed to explore temperature and precipitation patterns across the districts of Tamil Nadu, India.

The project uses NASA Earth observation datasets, including MERRA-2 for atmospheric temperature and GPM IMERG for precipitation, to help users understand regional climate variations and long-term trends. Through an interactive Tamil Nadu district map, data visualizations, and district-level comparisons, users can explore climate information in a more accessible and understandable way.

TerraTrend aims to bridge the gap between complex satellite-derived climate data and practical understanding. By presenting climate information through interactive maps, charts, and comparisons, the platform can support students, researchers, and communities in exploring regional climate patterns and understanding environmental changes.

Our goal is to make NASA Earth science data more accessible and encourage data-driven awareness of climate trends.
details:
TerraTrend is an interactive web-based climate exploration platform focused on Tamil Nadu, India. It aims to make NASA Earth observation data easier to understand through district-level maps, visualizations, and comparisons.

HOW IT WORKS:

  1. Users can explore Tamil Nadu through an interactive district map.
  2. The platform presents temperature and precipitation information through charts and data visualizations.
  3. Users can explore annual and monthly climate trends and compare different districts.
  4. A data transparency section identifies the NASA datasets used and displays their current verification status.

TECHNOLOGIES USED:

  • Frontend: React.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Vite.
  • Backend: Python and FastAPI.
  • Data visualization: Recharts.
  • Interactive mapping: Leaflet and React-Leaflet.
  • Geographic data: GeoJSON.
  • Scientific data sources: NASA MERRA-2 and NASA GPM IMERG.

BENEFITS AND INTENDED IMPACT:

TerraTrend makes complex climate information more accessible to students, researchers, and communities. It provides an interactive way to explore regional differences in climate variables and encourages awareness of environmental changes. The platform could support educational activities and preliminary climate exploration.

CREATIVITY AND DESIGN:

The project combines geographic visualization, district-level comparisons, climate charts, and dataset transparency in a single platform. Rather than presenting raw scientific data, TerraTrend aims to provide a user-friendly interface for exploring climate information.

DATA ACCURACY:

We recognize that satellite-derived data requires appropriate processing, spatial aggregation, and validation before drawing scientific conclusions. Dataset coverage and verification status are therefore presented transparently, and unverified data is not represented as fully validated scientific evidence.
